# PKC Events - Complete Knowledge Base

> Pride Kitchen Caterers & Events is a luxury event management and catering enterprise based in Thrissur, Kerala, India, operating since 2008.

## Core Specializations
1. Luxury Wedding Planning & Execution
2. Premium Catering Services (Authentic Kerala Sadhya & Multi-Cuisine Gourmet)
3. Event Venue Selection & Booking
4. Stage & Venue Decoration
5. Professional Photography & Cinematic Videography
6. Bridal Makeup & Styling
7. Luxury & Vintage Car Rentals
8. Corporate Event Management

## Certifications & Quality Assurance
- ISO 22000:2018 Certified (Food Safety Management Systems)
- FSSAI Licensed (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)
- Metro Food Award Winner (2023, 2024, 2025)
